name: Hidden Flask
body:
You excel at concealing and retrieving hidden reservoirs of liquid—good for the long dungeon crawl or the long day at work.

Prerequisite: Sleight of Hand 1 rank

Benefit: You can retrieve a hidden item as a move action that doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity. You can avoid attacks of opportunity from retrieving a stored item, drinking a potion, applying an oil, or reading a scroll by succeeding on a Sleight of Hand check with a DC equal to the opponent’s CMD. You get a +2 bonus on this check and on checks to hide small objects on your body.
